input.quote: ARTICLE XXI EFFECT OF TERMINATION Upon termination of this Agreement: for any reason (a) the rights and licenses granted to Licensee pursuant to this Agreement will automatically terminate, and (b) Licensee shall, within five (5) days, ship to Licensor all Licensed Technology, API's Documentation with respect to the Licensed Technology and other Confidential Information in Licensee's possession or control
input.rationale: The agreement contains no post-termination transition assistance or data-return obligation on Licensor. Article XXI (Effect of Termination) is entirely one-directional: licenses terminate immediately and Licensee must ship back all Licensed Technology, documentation and Confidential Information within five days with officer certification; nothing requires Licensor to return or export our data or to support an orderly exit. Article XX permits automatic termination on a Change of Control, and General Provisions (p0144-p0160) contain no exit, migration or data-export terms. The confidentiality article (p0123-p0125) binds only Licensee on nondisclosure and non-solicitation and does not address return of our data. Because we access market data, enter orders and generate trade/order records through the hosted Licensed Technology, the absence of any data return is walk-away territory under this rule. Inserted the preferred position at Article XXI: up to six months' transition assistance at then-current rates, return of Licensee data in a commonly used machine-readable format within thirty days, and certified deletion thereafter (with a carve-out for legally required retention); 90 days of assistance is the available fallback.

proposal.summary: Insert post-termination transition assistance and Licensee data return/deletion obligations into Article XXI (Effect of Termination).
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Article XXI only requires us to return Licensor materials, with nothing on our side coming back. We added an orderly exit: up to six months of transition assistance at Licensor's then-current rates, return of our data in a machine-readable format within thirty days, and certified deletion thereafter. We can work with 90 days of assistance if six months is a problem.

ops.text: (c) TRANSITION ASSISTANCE AND RETURN OF LICENSEE DATA. Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Licensor shall (i) at Licensee's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for a period of up to six (6) months at Licensor's then-current rates; (ii) within thirty (30) days of such request, return to Licensee all data and records of Licensee, and all trade, order and account data generated by or on behalf of Licensee, in Licensor's possession or control, in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (iii) thereafter delete such data from its systems and certify such deletion to Licensee in writing, except to the extent retention is required by applicable law or regulation.
